sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "copied_from_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "paused_at" INTEGER NULL, "purchased_on" TEXT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NULL, "store" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "receipt_key" TEXT NULL, "receipt_name" TEXT NULL, "receipt_type" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shopping_one_active ON shopping_lists (status) WHERE status = 'active'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_purchased" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_purchased" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX shopping_items_list ON shopping_items (list_id, position)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expiry_date" TEXT NULL, "expiry_reminder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("expiry_reminder" IN (0, 1)), "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), "drive_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'notUploaded', "drive_file_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX documents_expiry ON documents (expiry_date)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents_fts" USING fts5(title, description, original_name, content='documents', content_rowid='rowid');

CREATE TRIGGER documents_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON documents BEGIN INSERT INTO documents_fts ("rowid", title, description, original_name) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.description, new.original_name);END

CREATE TRIGGER documents_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON documents BEGIN INSERT INTO documents_fts (documents_fts, "rowid", title, description, original_name) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.description, old.original_name);END

CREATE TRIGGER documents_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON documents BEGIN INSERT INTO documents_fts (documents_fts, "rowid", title, description, original_name) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.description, old.original_name);INSERT INTO documents_fts ("rowid", title, description, original_name) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.description, new.original_name);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "password_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "username" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "password" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "password_notes_fts" USING fts5(name, url, username, content='password_notes', content_rowid='rowid');
CREATE TRIGGER password_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON password_notes BEGIN INSERT INTO password_notes_fts ("rowid", name, url, username) VALUES (new."rowid", new.name, new.url, new.username);END

CREATE TRIGGER password_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON password_notes BEGIN INSERT INTO password_notes_fts (password_notes_fts, "rowid", name, url, username) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.name, old.url, old.username);END

CREATE TRIGGER password_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON password_notes BEGIN INSERT INTO password_notes_fts (password_notes_fts, "rowid", name, url, username) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.name, old.url, old.username);INSERT INTO password_notes_fts ("rowid", name, url, username) VALUES (new."rowid", new.name, new.url, new.username);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "fields_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "linked_document_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_entries_fts" USING fts5(title, search_text, content='personal_entries', content_rowid='rowid');
CREATE TRIGGER personal_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON personal_entries BEGIN INSERT INTO personal_entries_fts ("rowid", title, search_text) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.search_text);END

CREATE TRIGGER personal_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON personal_entries BEGIN INSERT INTO personal_entries_fts (personal_entries_fts, "rowid", title, search_text) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.search_text);END

CREATE TRIGGER personal_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON personal_entries BEGIN INSERT INTO personal_entries_fts (personal_entries_fts, "rowid", title, search_text) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.search_text);INSERT INTO personal_entries_fts ("rowid", title, search_text) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.search_text);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "content_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "plain_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes_fts" USING fts5(title, plain_text, tags, content='notes', content_rowid='rowid');
CREATE TRIGGER notes_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO notes_fts ("rowid", title, plain_text, tags) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.plain_text, new.tags);END
CREATE TRIGGER notes_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO notes_fts (notes_fts, "rowid", title, plain_text, tags) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.plain_text, old.tags);END

CREATE TRIGGER notes_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO notes_fts (notes_fts, "rowid", title, plain_text, tags) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.plain_text, old.tags);INSERT INTO notes_fts ("rowid", title, plain_text, tags) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.plain_text, new.tags);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "due_date" TEXT NULL, "reminder_at" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_checklist_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_done" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "anchor_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "repeat" TEXT NOT NULL, "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "spent_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("source", "source_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_amounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_month" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lending_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "person" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "given_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_on" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "remind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medicines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "times" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
